kpis.description_fr: Trésorerie + marketable securities ($2.7B cash + $2.2B titres) - runway critique pour biotech pre-revenue.
kpis.description_en: Cash + marketable securities ($2.7B cash + $2.2B securities) - critical runway metric for pre-revenue biotech.

kpis.description_fr: Dépenses R&D - principal poste de coût biotech, finance les Phase 3 batoclimab, brepocitinib, IMVT-1402.
kpis.description_en: R&D expenses - main biotech cost driver funding Phase 3 trials of batoclimab, brepocitinib, IMVT-1402.

kpis.description_fr: 8 approbations FDA depuis fondation 2014, incluant Vants transférés à Sumitomo. KPI track-record biotech.
kpis.description_en: 8 FDA approvals since 2014 founding (including Vants transferred to Sumitomo). Biotech track-record KPI.

kpis.description_fr: Phases 3 actives: batoclimab MG (positif), TED (H2 2025), brepocitinib DM (H2 2025), NIU (H1 2027). Pipeline cœur de valorisation.
kpis.description_en: Active Phase 3 trials: batoclimab MG (positive), TED (H2 2025), brepocitinib DM (H2 2025), NIU (H1 2027). Core valuation pipeline.

kpis.description_fr: 11 dernières études Phase 3 ont délivré données positives (incl. approbations) - signature track record exceptionnelle.
kpis.description_en: Last 11 Phase 3 studies yielded positive data (incl. approvals) - exceptional signature track record.

kpis_story.description_fr: Pulmovant filiale (PAH program) en développement. Modèle de spin-out continues (Telavant vendu $7 Mds RHHBY 2023). Plus de Vants en pipeline 2025.
kpis_story.description_en: Pulmovant subsidiary (PAH program) in development. Continuous spin-out model (Telavant sold $7B to RHHBY 2023). More Vants in pipeline 2025.

_notes: Fiscal year ends March 31. Pre-revenue biotech (VTAMA divested to Organon early 2025). 50.5% stake in Immunovant (public). Cash runway critical given $550M R&D burn rate.
